title: Really nice app, almost perfect
body: Lovely app, really helps me keep good habits. I would like the option of doing something 3 times a week, not necessarilly on the same day every week. For instance: do a workout 3x a week. Now you must plot it out on certain days.
author: EmmaAcha

title: De beste app en goed contact met de ontwikkelaar
body:
Bij vragen en suggesties per mail krijg je direct reactie. Vriendelijk en hulpvaardig. 
Bovendien de beste Habit-app die ik heb geprobeerd.
author: 10us Pluts

title: The best habit tracker app
body: Awesome Habit is the best habit-tracking app I’ve used. It’s polished, reliable, and requires no account—your data is stored securely in iCloud. Exporting data to CSV is simple and fast. I’ve tried many similar apps, but this one stands out as the best.
author: Sandpit6363

title: Minimalistic design
body: Great app to use. Nice widgets and not to expensive.
author: Mickosaurus

title: The best habits app I’ve used
body:
Has all features I want but no clutter and feels intuitive to use:
 - daily, weekly and monthly goals; and goals for only certain days of the week
 - countable goals (for instance walk x minutes a week), not only pass/fail
 - the function to skip habits for this day/week (helpful when sick or on vacation)
 - backup, export and import function

The premium fee is not expensive and a lifetime plan can be bought so that you don’t need a subscription.
author: BartC94

title: Simply genius!
body: The genius of the app is its simplicity and design. No account or login is needed. Does one thing and does that super well.
author: therookiepro

title: Minimalistic and gets the job done
body: If you're looking for a simple, yet intuitive habit tracker: this is what you've been searching for. The micro animations make it very pleasant to use. Would highly recommend this above all the other cluttered habit trackers. Well done!
author: ThiemeH

title: Good and intuitive but widget icons are super small
body: Widget icons are to small. It should be clearer what button I have to press in less than a second. Make them bigger and it is 5 stars! Premium is also on the more expensive side for comparable apps.
author: Thekopa

title: Best in the habit
body: This app is fantastic. I don’t usually buy anything that I can have for free but I could not find any other app that would have so many options, ease of use and great look that motivates me. And the biggest selling point- the widget. I can glance quickly at what else do I need to do . Bravo and thank you.
author: Kasiata

title: Very nice!
body: I bought the lifetime access (which is only 23€) and it works amazing! When I read all those comments about the amazing owner I thought it was too good to be true. I mailed him about a problem and in 2 hours he mailed back with the solution. Amazing!
author: stormsoares

title: Goed
body: Elke dag het beste uit jezelf halen. Deze app is het waard!
author: Jay999-

title: Geweldige tracker
body: Makkelijk in gebruik, mooie en duidelijke interface alsook handige functies en widgets. Fijne updates en de ontwikkelaar staat open voor feedback. Ook goedkoper dan vergelijkbare apps. Een aanrader!
author: Levanooo

title: Free version is very limited
body: The app seems perfect, until you find out you can only add 3 habits without buying the premium version :(
author: fhhddhb

title: A very positive app!
body: I tried several habit apps and this one is at the moment my number one.
author: Zorrosnor

title: amazing
body: It really helps you reach your goals. The reminders and adjustable options are truly amazing. I have made so many positive habit changes because of this app.
author: Melodie Croes

title: Awesome app
body:
Best habit app I ever used. Love the design as a designer myself. 

Would love to see a simple to do list app as well with this interface.
author: rutgerggg

title: Great
body:
Actually sticked to this app for over a month. It’s a bit expensive (still cheaper than similar apps) but it has been worth it so far. Really helped me to build good habits and break bad ones. 

I like that it syncs through iCloud so you can use it on all your devices (even Apple Watch), and that you can see the weekly/monthly breakdown of each habit. 

One thing I would still love to see is support for Shortcuts.
author: adriaanzon

title: Great app!
body: Very easy to use. If you love crossing things of a to do list, this app is for you! I find it really motivates me to develop and maintain good habits.
author: fyegjgcdrg

title: Love the design and functionalities
body: I had several apps to keep track of habits and this app gives me all in one. Love the design and use it daily from my iPad to keep me in track of my goals and habits, very user friendly design
author: Mariska_
